input: Exposure to toxic content is a risk associated with An automated content moderation system is designed to detect and flag videos that promote harmful behavior, using natural language processing to identify prohibited keywords and hashtags. The system aims to prevent the spread of such content by recognizing and filtering out violating material. It also seeks to stay ahead of attempts to bypass its detection capabilities through creative spelling or coding of search terms.
